Community Membership first value

Payment alone is not value.

A verified membership must connect the authorized person, correct profile or location, correct membership term and useful community tools.

SHOW ME
First value means usable value

Activation is not complete until the member can use the correct profile and member tools and can reach support and billing/cancellation controls.

  1. Confirm the exact terms. Show $5 monthly, $50 annual, or $120/36-month Charter terms, including recurring or non-renewing behavior.
  2. Connect the correct profile. Verify authority and preserve the real physical location or service area.
  3. Prepare the richer profile. Add member-provided description, services, images, contact routes, accessibility and language information.
  4. Choose one community action. Prepare an offer, event, contribution or participation idea where supported.
  5. Open the Growth Desk. Create a practical starter plan and appropriate English, Spanish or bilingual communication with review controls.
Activation boundary: paid first-value steps remain closed until payment is verified, the entitlement is saved persistently, support/billing controls work, and the controlled real transaction passes.
